UpdateStageDescription: Downloads the latest AssaultCube release from GitHub
Downloads the latest AssaultCube release from GitHub
Downloads the official 7-Zip tools used to unpack the AssaultCube installer
Downloads the official 7-Zip tools used to unpack the AssaultCube installer
Unpacks the installer into a temporary folder, then copies it into the server folder without replacing existing config files
UpdateSourceArgs: /C cd /D "{{$FullRootDir}}." & (if not exist ac-tools\7z.exe ac-tools\7zr.exe x -y -oac-tools ac-tools\7z-x64.exe 7z.exe 7z.dll > NUL) & rd /S /Q ac-install > NUL 2>&1 & for %f in (ac-download\AssaultCube_v*.exe) do (ac-tools\7z.exe x -y -oac-install -x!$PLUGINSDIR -x!$TEMP "%f" > NUL) & if not exist ac-install\bin_win32\ac_server.exe (echo AssaultCube installer could not be unpacked & exit /b 1) else (robocopy ac-install\config "{{$FullBaseDir}}config" /E /XC /XN /XO /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP > NUL & robocopy ac-install "{{$FullBaseDir}}." /E /XD config /XF Uninstall.exe /NFL /NDL /NJH /NJS /NP > NUL & rd /S /Q ac-install ac-download > NUL 2>&1 & cd /D "{{$FullBaseDir}}." & copy /Y bin_win32\ac_server.exe ac_server.exe > NUL & copy /Y bin_win32\SDL2.dll SDL2.dll > NUL & copy /Y bin_win32\zlib1.dll zlib1.dll > NUL & (if exist config\servercmdline.txt powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$p='config\servercmdline.txt'; (Get-Content $p) -replace '^\s*-Y\s+A{64}', '// $0' | Set-Content $p") & if not exist ac_server.exe (exit /b 1) else (echo AssaultCube installed/updated & exit /b 0))

UpdateStageDescription: Extracts the release into a temporary folder, then copies it into the server folder without replacing existing config files
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\" && rm -rf ac-install && mkdir -p ac-install \"{{$FullBaseDir}}config\" && tar -xjf ac-download/AssaultCube_v*.tar.bz2 -C ac-install && cp -rn ac-install/config/. \"{{$FullBaseDir}}config/\" && rm -rf ac-install/config && cp -rf ac-install/. \"{{$FullBaseDir}}\" && { [ ! -f \"{{$FullBaseDir}}config/servercmdline.txt\" ] || sed -i -E 's|^[[:space:]]*-Y[[:space:]]+A{64}|// &|' \"{{$FullBaseDir}}config/servercmdline.txt\"; } && chmod +x \"{{$FullBaseDir}}bin_unix/linux_64_server\" && rm -rf ac-install ac-download && echo 'AssaultCube installed/updated'"
